overview_description.description: MAYDAY utilizes a sharing economy model connecting "providers" in this case tow trucks or car drivers with motorists in need of assistance across Cairo & Giza. MAYDAY offers a range of services to its users including Battery jump start, Fuel delivery, tire change or Towing all delivered in less than 30 minutes. MAYDAY offers a safe and hassle free experience to its users while utilizing location-based services to guarantee a rapid response and dispatch process.
